BUY: Kratos Defense sourced from the standard watchlist screen (quant score driven by 30.5% revenue growth). Also passed on HIMS (opportunity-tier, decent growth but an active new investor class-action lawsuit plus FDA compounded-GLP-1 warnings and Visa dispute-monitoring -- too much fresh legal/regulatory overhang for the size of the opportunity), LEU (a dilutive $500M share offering just hit the stock, in the middle of digesting that news), and META (up 11.4% in a single day on the Muse app-store pop heading into Meta Connect -- momentum-chasing entry, not a value-conscious one). Opportunity-tier (~$8.8B market cap); sized to the available cash above the 2% buffer floor (~$20.11), the binding constraint today (ample remaining room in both the Industrials sector cap and the opportunity bucket).
